KPlugin.Name: Window Size Presets
KPlugin.Description: Adds a "Window Size" submenu with preset sizes to the window menu (Alt+F3 or right-click on the titlebar); handy when a window is larger than the screen and can't be resized with the mouse
KPlugin.Description[zh_CN]: 在窗口菜单（Alt+F3 或标题栏右键）中加入“窗口尺寸”子菜单：窗口超出屏幕、鼠标无法调整大小时，可一键把窗口设为 800×600 等预设尺寸
